intro: This is a familiar calendar with a different year number. The model keeps Gregorian months, days and leap years, but calls 2026 CE the year 2569 Buddhist Era (B.E.).
summary: Same everyday dates; the year number is 543 higher.
epoch: The year count is associated with a traditional Buddhist chronology. For contemporary Thai-style civil dates, subtract 543 to read the Gregorian year.
epoch_heading: WHAT DOES THE YEAR NUMBER MEAN?
year_rule: The months and their lengths follow the Gregorian calendar. January begins the year and February has 29 days in Gregorian leap years. The Buddhist Era year number is Gregorian year + 543.
bar_highlight: YEAR NUMBER: +543 RELATIVE TO COMMON ERA
after_note: Example: 1 January 2026 CE is 1 January 2569 B.E. under this model. Only the year number changes.
history: Buddhist Era year numbering commemorates a traditional chronology associated with the Buddha. Thailand uses Buddhist Era numbers widely for civil dates. Other Buddhist communities may begin their years differently; this particular provider uses the Gregorian calendar with a +543 era offset.
limits: This is not a universal historical Buddhist calendar. It does not reproduce Thailand's former April New Year or every regional religious convention.
title: Buddhist Era Calendar
